text_block_list.text:
During the second overseas training. It 
happened during free time――!
choice_data_list: The subway has stopped!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh? For real? Oh no~! Our transportation 
just vanished!?
choice_data_list: The subway's stopped?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No way~! In that case――
choice_data_list: ...Ah, yeah.
...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's just walk! I totally wanted to 
explore around here more anyway~♪

Those words reminded me of the first day 
of overseas training. Back then, did 
fretting over things ever solve anything? 
Times like this are precisely when...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're up for it? Then let's go 
together!
choice_data_list: I love that idea!
Nice! I like that!

text_block_list.text:
And so, we ended up strolling around with 
Vivlos while heading toward the hotel we 
were staying at.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Over here,
over here~! I totally wanted to 
look at souvenirs~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I already bought presents for my big 
sisters, so this time it's for myself!
choice_data_list: Sounds great, I'll pick something ...
Sounds great, I'll pick something ...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there are tons of ship motifs,
aren't 
there? Is it because we're close to the 
sea?
choice_data_list: Sounds good, I'll pick one too!
Sounds good, I'll pick one too!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's because sightseeing boats 
depart from here. They're the symbol of 
this town."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah~! It's like a luxury cruise liner! 
Where can you go sightseeing? I'm so 
curious~!
choice_data_list: I'll go check the destination!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, we scored some transportation~!
choice_data_list: I'll go check where we're headed!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Plu-u-us, we can even eat while gazing at 
the ocean! That's, like, totally 
celebrity-style~!
choice_data_list: Now we can cross over to the other...
Now we can cross over to the other...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's live music too~, we're 
gonna have such a wonderful time~!

text_block_list.name: Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
"Please take your time and enjoy 
yourselves. You might even spot dolphins 
around these waters."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: !!!!! I wanna see dolphins!!
choice_data_list: Isn't that one between those waves?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, where, where!? Wait, gotta take a 
photo, a photo!
choice_data_list: Isn't that it out between the waves?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! Ahh, that was so fun! We got 
souvenirs~, and took a boat trip!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And we even found a cafe that wasn't 
listed in any guidebook!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Having the subway stop might've actually 
been a good thing~!
choice_data_list: It's all in how you look at it!
It's all in how you look at it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! I mean,
most things work out 
in the end anyway, yeah?
choice_data_list: It's all in how you look at it!
It's all in how you look at it, huh!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I think it's way more rewarding to stay 
positive~!

...Even if that's true, in reality, doing 
so is usually quite difficult.

If I had just stayed there brooding back 
then, obsessed only with getting back, I 
never would have enjoyed myself this much.
choice_data_list: ――Truly, thank you for inviting me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way, not at a-a-all! I had so much fun 
too~!
choice_data_list: ――Thank you so much for inviting me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I might've been the one who invited you, 
but Trainer-san was the one who went
along 
with it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And with that! To this wonderful day~... 
Cheers!
